messages:
maeve: Handoff — monitoring GPU pools this shift. Average util for 'inference-pool-1' now 68% over last hour, burst headroom 12%. Customer 'scribe' has had a sustained embedding job; last 15m concurrency +3x. I'm oncall until 10:30 PST. Watch for queue growth and burst depletion. Key checks: `redwoodctl pools describe inference-pool-1` and check /metrics/gpu_util. If you see burst_used > 80% or queue_length > 200, consider enabling temporary burst from reserved-pools or raise autoscale min.

liam: :eyes: where's the dashboard link? also do we have a quick mitigation to drop quality to save tokens?

maeve: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/pools/inference-pool-1?daterange=1h . For quality knob we can switch model to quantized variant `gptq-3-small` via routing policy or enable reduce_max_tokens to 512 on the route. I wouldn't change routing unless traffic spikes more.

sanjay: FYI saw a small spike around 01:12 UTC from customer 'arbor' - their job pattern looks like nightly batch. I'll open RLW-482 to track. :memo:

ops-bot: Alert: burst-usage threshold crossed for inference-pool-1 (burst_used=82%). Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alert/8272

anya: I can flip a temporary scale-up if needed. Which machine type do we prefer for short-lived burst? p4d? or cheaper a10g?

maeve: Prefer a10g for quick scale — cheaper and warm. If you scale, set autoscale cooldown 3m and set target_latency=120ms. I'll stay glued to logs for the next 45m.

liam: I'll watch logs and pre-approve a10g scale. Also pinged solutions about the Scribe job to maybe reschedule.

sanjay: Opened RLW-482 with timestamps and sample request ids. assigned to @maeve for follow-up.

maeve: Thanks. One more: don't touch model rollouts scheduled at 03:00 UTC (RLW-499) — that could change kernel selection and affect latency. If incident, fallback to prior config via rollback tag `v2026-02-14`.

liam: noted. :thumbsup:

maeve: Signing off handoff to @liam for next hour. If anything urgent, call or Slack me. :phone:

liam: taking over. glhf :shipit:
